edges.why: Decision step 2 (aggregation): SAGE II solar occultation profiles gridded into monthly 5° zonal means are the core of the record; PARENT.
Decision step 3: SAGE I (1979–1981) forms the pre-SAGE II record; INPUT.
Decision step 3: SAM II 1000-nm data fill the high latitudes before SAGE II; INPUT.
Decision step 3: CLAES fills the post-Pinatubo gap (1991–1993); INPUT. Mapped to the Level 3AT profile product (inferred).
Decision step 3: HALOE 3.40-µm aerosol extinction (1991–2005) fills SAGE II gaps; INPUT. Mapped to the Level 2 product, the only HALOE product covering 1991–2005 (inferred).
Decision step 3: CALIOP version 4 level 1 nighttime backscatter converted to extinction after 2006; INPUT. CMR holds only V4-51 of the V4 L1 releases (the release used in 2018 is not in CMR).

Decision step 2 (aggregation): SAGE II solar occultation profiles gridded into monthly 5° zonal means are the core of the record; PARENT. Inferred for this version: the 2.x changes concern the post-2005 record (version history).
Decision step 3: SAGE I (1979–1981) forms the pre-SAGE II record; INPUT. Inferred for this version: the 2.x changes concern the post-2005 record (version history).
Decision step 3: SAM II 1000-nm data fill the high latitudes before SAGE II; INPUT. Inferred for this version: the 2.x changes concern the post-2005 record (version history).
Decision step 3: CLAES fills the post-Pinatubo gap (1991–1993); INPUT. Mapped to the Level 3AT profile product (inferred).

Decision step 3: HALOE 3.40-µm aerosol extinction (1991–2005) fills SAGE II gaps; INPUT. Mapped to the Level 2 product, the only HALOE product covering 1991–2005 (inferred). Inferred for this version: the 2.x changes concern the post-2005 record (version history).
Decision step 3: the CALIPSO Lidar Level 3 stratospheric aerosol monthly profiles (V1.00) replace the Level 1 data from version 2.0; INPUT.

Decision step 3: SAGE III/ISS solar-event profiles extend the record from June 2017 and anchor the OSIRIS/CALIPSO conformance; INPUT. Product mapped to the monthly NetCDF solar-event profiles (inferred).
fixed_version: the SAGE III/ISS version used is not stated; 53 is the earliest version in CMR
